episodes.synopsis: The Taira clan, also known as the Heike, has reached unprecedented power and influence in Japan. Through strange and terrible circumstances, a biwa-playing girl finds herself enmeshed in the story of their political strife.
episodes.title: If You Don't Belong to the Heike, You Won't Be a Person

episodes.synopsis: Shigemori rushes to deal with the fallout of Kiyomori's assault on the regent. As Biwa spends more time with Shigemori's family, she begins to open up.
episodes.title: The Glory of the Corrupt World Is a Dream in a Dream

episodes.synopsis: After the passage of several years, Biwa catches up with a friend. A clash with the Enryakuji monks bodes ill for the Heike, and Shigemori is compelled to take drastic action to restrain Kiyomori.
episodes.title: Shishigatani Incident

episodes.synopsis: Tokuko finally carries Emperor Takakura's child. The prospect of an emperor from the Taira lineage is a happy tiding, but the prospect of Kiyomori's tightening grip on power bodes ill.
episodes.title: Unwritten Affair

episodes.synopsis: Shigemori's passing hits Kiyomori hard. However, with Shigemori gone, no one is left to stand up to Kiyomori, leaving his whims and ambitions unchecked.
episodes.title: Bridge Battle

episodes.synopsis: Kiyomori moves the capital to Fukuhara, a new figure moves against the Heike, and Koremori is charged with leading the counterattack.
episodes.title: City Transition

episodes.synopsis: The capital is moved back to present-day Kyoto.Amidst the political turmoil the move ignites, Biwa and the others are shaken by unexpected deaths.
episodes.title: Kiyomori, Dies

episodes.synopsis: Having been kicked out of her home, Biwa sets off on a journey for clues about her mother. The Heike's military challenges continue.
episodes.title: Leaving the Capital

episodes.synopsis: A chance encounter leads Biwa to her mother. The Heike take refuge in Dazaifu, but their respite is cut short.
episodes.title: Heike Flowing

episodes.synopsis: Having discovered her purpose, Biwa returns to the Heike to witness events play out. The final clash between the Heike and the Genji approaches.
episodes.title: Dan-no-ura

episodes.synopsis: Biwa witnesses the final clash between the Heike and the Genji. In the aftermath, Biwa sets out to tell the Heike's story.
episodes.title: The Impermanence of Worldly Things
